easy-trade.config.title: easy-trade Settings
easy-trade.config.tooltip.enabled: Disabling stops quick trade without deleting saved bookmarks.
easy-trade.config.tooltip.action_delay: Base wait between opening, selecting and taking the result.
easy-trade.config.tooltip.jitter: Maximum random delay added independently to every step.
easy-trade.config.tooltip.cooldown: Wait before another right-click can start quick trade.
easy-trade.config.tooltip.menu_timeout: Maximum wait for the server to open the menu and send offers.
easy-trade.config.tooltip.sync_timeout: Maximum wait for the server slot update after submitting a trade.
easy-trade.no_change: No trade completed; check materials and inventory space
easy-trade.confirm_timeout: Trade submitted, but server confirmation timed out
easy-trade.reason.no_villager: Cannot identify the villager for this screen
easy-trade.reason.menu_timeout: the server did not open a merchant menu
easy-trade.reason.menu_replaced: the merchant menu was closed or replaced
easy-trade.reason.offers_timeout: the server did not send merchant offers
easy-trade.reason.offer_missing: the bookmarked offer is no longer available
easy-trade.reason.out_of_stock: the bookmarked offer is out of stock
easy-trade.reason.offer_changed: the merchant offer changed before selection
easy-trade.reason.no_materials: not enough materials for the bookmarked trade
easy-trade.command.status: easy-trade: %s, base delay %s ms, jitter 0–%s ms
